Flows · Fewer no-shows for physio clinics

Draw: drag the boxes, add one from the toolbar, join two with an arrow, double-click to rename, a dashed arrow for abandonment. Text: the same flow as Mermaid, redrawn as you type. When it says what you mean, copy the changes and give them to the agent, or save them and run node scripts/bos.mjs flows --apply flows-edited.md. DESIGN.md stays the record; state diagrams are edited as text.
